name: @squirrelscan/dom-classifier-v2
description: The one featurizer + silver labeller for DOM classifier v2 (#2307). Experiment code: not published, not imported by the CLI yet.
notes: linkedom is reached through ../../../packages/parser/src/dom.ts, which is the SAME parse entry the CLI uses (attribute-case patch included). It resolves from packages/parser/node_modules, so nothing needs installing here.

tldts is used ONLY by build-dataset.ts, for the registrable domain that keys the train/val/holdout split. It resolves from a local node_modules symlink into packages/crawler/node_modules; run `ln -s ../../../../packages/crawler/node_modules/tldts node_modules/tldts` if it is missing.
Nothing here is installed with bun install: an install in this directory re-resolves the workspace.
